summary: Integrated agent cam_live.agent.CamLiveAgent (contracts.AgentAPI + drain_experiments + explain_obstacle; build_agent factory) composed only from the workstreams' components, driven by runtime.loop.LiveRuntime. Contract 1.1 (additive change requests, APPLIED.md). CPU integration tests (LabWorld + PolicyService + signing LabVerifier over several verified lifetimes; save -> fresh process -> load; kill -9 -> restart) and the Phase-4 staging validation cam_live.validation.run_staging (real Qwen3-4B + 50m core on the GPU; computer environment with the staging sites, Chromium and the staging Discord service; LabWorld family).

IN-01.limitations: Every workstream's learning component is called by the agent in the runtime loop; the computer environment's executors (browser, http, Discord staging) only in the staging validation; sandbox, visual and skill executors are not registered there; CheckpointManager promotion is not called.

IN-07.limitations: Pathway shown on LabWorld (diagnostic) and the staging services; no live service.

LX-11.limitations: Three real-configuration staging runs executed; none passes every check: no reward meta-update with a non-zero meta-gradient on the real model (runs 1, 3: none applied; run 2: one recorded as applied with a zero gradient and unchanged psi); runs 2 and 3 ran out of their time budget before the second LabWorld lifetime on a loaded machine. All other checks held in run 1.

NA-06.limitations: The trainable policy selects among candidates (rule 'policy'); the change of its distribution on a held-out context is attributed to the weights by restoring them. Debug scale in the tests.

CU-22.limitations: Neural updates from interaction experience: LabWorld (tests) and the staging computer environment (validation). No comparison against the skill library's contribution.

commands: cd /workspace/camlive && .venv/bin/python -c "from cam_live.validation import run_staging, EVIDENCE_DIR; run_staging(None, real_model=True, n_decisions=40, evidence_dir=EVIDENCE_DIR)"
CU-30.limitations: Browser / HTTP / staging Discord actions chosen by the agent on the staging sites (validation phase A); task success on those interfaces is not established.

CL-09.limitations: Transfer of the kept knowledge to a new objective is not measured here (workstream S).

CL-06.limitations: Bit-identical decisions across processes with the same PYTHONHASHSEED; with different hash seeds the probabilities differed by < 1e-8 and the reward-parameter hash after a meta-update.

AE-03.limitations: Self-directed experiments (randomised comparisons, registered) run in the loop; their usefulness is not evaluated.

AE-04.limitations: GoalFreeMode is wired into propose / select / resolution (goals proposed from the fast posterior, the chosen one resolved from what was observed, the others abandoned, nothing admitted to the meta ledger); exercised by one CPU test without the runtime; usefulness for later objectives is not measured.

AE-05.limitations: Several LabWorld objectives and the staging computer task in one lifetime of one agent.

AE-08.limitations: explain_obstacle gives data-driven explanations (Dirichlet over observed failure classes); strategy changes are not measured.

MR-05.limitations: Applied meta-updates with non-zero meta-gradients at debug scale; an applied update with an exactly zero meta-gradient was also recorded as applied (Adam momentum still moves psi; reported to C).

SV-11.limitations: Every number in this file comes from the commands listed.

not_done: No live service was contacted; every result is LabWorld (diagnostic) or the local staging services (staging). Nothing here is evidence about the Discord objective.

Learning quality is not established: the tests and the staging runs show the pathway (non-zero updates, meta-gradients at debug scale, a behaviour change that lives in the weights), not that decisions get better.
runtime.loop_service does not pass the verifier to build_agent (M-int-1): under cam-live run the agent refuses verified outcomes for supervision until attach_verifier is called.
runtime.verifier does not sign measurements (M-int-3): in a real run only signed objective outcomes can supervise the meta objective.

runtime.loop consumes the authorization grant before env.execute (M-int-6): with ComputerEnvironment + PolicyService every action is refused unless the runtime is given cam_live.validation.LookOnlyGrants (done in the staging validation only).
cam-live validate --mode staging calls run_staging(cfg) without options (M-int-2); the defaults run the real-model validation.

Save -> fresh process -> load: decisions are the same and the first is bit-identical; later probabilities agree to ~1e-7 and the reward-parameter hash can differ after a meta-update (summation order on the meta / learning path, not located).

Sandbox (code), visual and skill executors were part of the staging computer environment only in run 3 (harness.factories.all_executors, 80 tools), where the agent made 2 decisions; none of their tools was exercised by the agent.
In the staging computer environment the agent's actions were mostly element-less clicks / fills (schema-valid, environment-invalid) and inspections; no staging task was completed there.
CheckpointManager promotion / rollback and weights-only export are not called by the agent (the runtime's own checkpoints are used).
The planner's imagined values are recorded as candidate extras only when its horizon controller allows >= 1 step; no selection rule uses them.
Goal-free mode is exercised by one CPU test (goals proposed, chosen, resolved, abandoned, none admitted to the meta ledger); its usefulness for later objectives is not measured.
The integration tests ran in a worktree where other agents changed reward/, credit/ and runtime/ concurrently; the final JUnit is from a copy of the committed tree plus M-int's files.

reward.metalearner records an update with an exactly zero meta-gradient as applied (staging run 2); Adam then leaves psi unchanged on the first step but moves it on later steps through its moments (seen at debug scale). Reported here for workstream C; not changed by M-int.
scientific_failures: Real configuration (Qwen3-4B + 50m core), three staging runs: no reward meta-update with a non-zero meta-gradient was observed. Run 1: 26 skips (insufficient independent verified outcomes; both LabWorld lifetimes reached their targets after 8 decisions). Run 2: one update recorded as applied by reward.metalearner with an importance-weighted meta-gradient of exactly 0 and unchanged reward parameters, 19 skips. Run 3: 9 decisions only (loaded machine), no update.
Behaviour change on the held-out context is small (TV 0.010 - 0.026 on the real configuration) and its direction (better or worse decisions) is not evaluated.
